notes.title: [Patch v1.9.1] Fixes and QOL to Accessibility Console
notes.notes:
Here are some fixes and quality of life improvements as per the feedback from the community:

[list]
[*] Fixed callout 'Loading Cancelled' on saves file loading.

Updated the Demo version with the same fixes.

notes.title: [v1.9.0] Accessibility Console
notes.notes:
[h1]Accessibility Console[/h1]

This took me almost a year of weekends/evenings to build: I have implemented a new way to interact with the game via console commands. Pressing 'F2' anywhere in the game will open up a console. This will allow interacting with the whole game entirely via keyboard commands and text to speech.

[b]This mode will allow blind and visually impaired players to play the game.[/b]

Even with the console open, it is still possible to interact with the game via mouse and other user interface elements if needed.

[h1]New[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability to auto-pay using wounds
[*] Added hotkey "Alpha7" for market special location cards
[/list]

[h1]Modding[/h1]
Now supporting language mods - as long as the default game fonts can load the special characters.

notes.title: Editor Tool to create content
notes.notes:
As part of improving modding support for the game, I finally had the time to create a [url=https://yohanlaunay.github.io/paladins-oath-editor/]web-based tool[/url] to allow people to create content for Paladin's Oath.

Previously you had to fiddle with text files and create proper folder structure, etc. 

You can now instead visit the [url=https://yohanlaunay.github.io/paladins-oath-editor/]Paladin's Oath Editor webpage[/url] to download sample content and [b]create your own content[/b] directly from the editor; then head to the game to publish your mod onto Steam via the Workshop and share with the rest of the community!

[b]I hope you can get the creative juices flowing!
[/b]
As usual ping me on Discord or Steam/Steam Community if you have questions or issues with the game or editor.

And don't forget to check out the [url=https://paladinsoath.fandom.com/wiki/Creating_Mods_for_the_Game]wiki for a detailed guide[/url] on how mods work with the game.

The source code for the editor is [url=https://github.com/yohanlaunay/paladins-oath-editor]publicly accessible too[/url] if you want to go the extra miles and make changes there (or just learn how it works).

[h3]Supports:[/h3]
[list]
[*] - Character creation
[*] - Enemy creation
[*] - Oath creation
[*] - Terrain and Map Sections creation
[/list]

[h3]Not supported:[/h3]
LUA Scripted mods (scenario extensions and scenarios).

notes.title: [v1.6.0] Support for Custom Mods
notes.notes:
[h1]Modding Support[/h1]

The game now has the ability to install custom mods as well as publish new mods to Steam Workshop directly from within the Game Options.

Mods can be created easily using one of the sample mods provided (see Wiki link below), and typically include some JSON and image files.

The game currently support the creation of:
[list]
[*] Custom Enemies
[*] Custom Terrain Hexes
[*] Custom Map Sections (7 hexes)
[*] Custom Characters - but relying on existing cards/followers/blessings
[*] Custom Oaths (for existing or new characters)
[/list]

See wiki for full details on how to install and create mods:
[url=https://paladinsoath.fandom.com/wiki/Mods]https://paladinsoath.fandom.com/wiki/Mods[/url]

Please join the [url=https://discord.gg/PqFpUJGc3T]Discord channel[/url] to share your mods with the rest of the community and discuss technical details.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Option to use single color for cards text for improved readability
[*] Option to increase the max font size for cards/followers/blessings
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: [v1.5.0] Added Score computation per Scenario
notes.notes:
Added score tracking to the crusades.

The score is accessible in the Pause Menu ('Esc', "scores" button on top) and displayed at the end of the Crusade.

The scoring will depend on the scenario but will also account for categories like XP, number of wounds, followers recruited, relics, conquered locations and citadels, etc.

Scoring categories are quite comprehensive and will also show the settings used when configuring the crusade so that others can attempt the same scenario under the same conditions.

notes.title: [v1.0.0] Game Released
notes.notes:
After 1.5 years of development the game is finally ready for release.

A big thank you to everyone that contributed and special thanks to the 100+ playtesters that helped make this game possible!

To celebrate the launch, I've created a Bundle that basically gives you access to my previous game [b]Mighty Dungeons[/b] for free (or close to it) if you buy Paladin's Oath
